# Evoke Corporate Entertainment

> Established in 2009, Evoke Entertainment prides ourselves on delivering world-class entertainment for Corporate Events, Weddings &amp; Private Events. Our impressive, talented lineup of artists include Singers, Bands, DJs, Duos/Trios, String Quartets, MCs and more.
